'''Yūichi Nakamura''' (Japanese: '''中村悠一''' ''Nakamura Yūichi'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}. 

==Biography==
Nakamura was born on May 20, 1980 in {{wp|Aji, Kagawa|Aji}}, {{wp|Kagawa Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}} and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|BW}}, where he voiced {{an|N}}, one of {{Ash}}'s temporary {{ashfr|traveling partners}}. He gained a more significant role in {{aniseries|JN}} as the voice of [[Professor Cerise]]. Nakamura is currently affiliated with the talent agency INTENTION.
